CVE-2024-25178:
local n
local function f(x, y)
  n = n + 1
  f()
end

-- Do all these on a fresh coroutine, to maximise available stack space.

do -- Should be able to reach a decent stack depth before erroring.
  coroutine.wrap(function()
    n = 0
    local ok, err = pcall(f)
    assert(n >= 16300)
    assert(not ok)
    assert((err:find'stack overflow'))
  end)()
end
do -- Should be able to reach a decent stack depth before erroring, then call handler.
  coroutine.wrap(function()
    local function goodef(err)
      assert((err:find'stack overflow'))
      return 'goodef ran'
    end
    n = 0
    local ok, err = xpcall(f, goodef)
    assert(n >= 16300)
    assert(not ok)
    assert((err:find'goodef ran'), err)
  end)()
end
do -- If handler messes up, should still get a stack overflow error.
  coroutine.wrap(function()
    local function badef(x, y) badef() end
    n = 0
    local ok, err = xpcall(f, badef)
    assert(n >= 16300)
    assert(not ok)
    assert((err:find'stack overflow'))
  end)()
end
do -- debug.traceback should work as a handler.
  coroutine.wrap(function()
    n = 0
    local ok, err = xpcall(f, debug.traceback)
    assert(n >= 16300)
    assert(not ok)
    assert((err:find'stack overflow'))
    assert(select(2, err:gsub('in function', '')) >= 15)
  end)()
end
